name: SUM
description: SUM adds all the numbers in a range of cells and returns the total.
tldr: SUM calculates the sum of numeric values in a range.

parameters.name: number1
parameters.description: The first number, cell reference, or range to add.

parameters.name: number2
parameters.description: Optional additional numbers, cell references, or ranges to add.

basicExample.explanation: Adds all numeric values in cells A1 through A10.

advancedExamples.title: Sum across multiple sheets
advancedExamples.description: Sum the same range across multiple worksheets
advancedExamples.explanation: Adds values from A1:A10 across Sheet1, Sheet2, and Sheet3.

advancedExamples.title: Conditional sum with SUMIF
advancedExamples.description: Sum only values that meet a condition
advancedExamples.explanation: SUMIF adds only values greater than 100.

howItWorks: SUM iterates through each cell in the specified range, adds up numeric values, and ignores text, blank cells, and error values.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the sum should appear.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the total sum.

limitations: SUM ignores text and blank cells.
For conditional summing, use SUMIF or SUMIFS.

commonErrors.cause: Text or error values in the range
commonErrors.fix: Check for non-numeric values or use SUMIF to exclude errors.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: SUM works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Can SUM handle negative numbers?
faq.answer: Yes, SUM correctly adds positive and negative numbers.

faq.question: Does SUM ignore errors?
faq.answer: No, if any cell contains an error, SUM returns that error. Use AGGREGATE or SUMIF to ignore errors.
